facts.statement: Yuanjiawaornis is classified as an extinct genus of large enantiornithean bird.
facts.quote: Yuanjiawaornis is an extinct genus of large enantiornithean bird

facts.statement: The animal lived during the Early Cretaceous in what is now China.
facts.quote: known from the early Cretaceous of present-day China

facts.statement: The fossil was excavated in 2005 by a museum team in Liaoning and formally named in 2015.
facts.quote: Excavated in 2005 by a museum team in the famous fossil-bearing layers of Liaoning, it was named in 2015

facts.statement: The species was described by Hu Dongyu, Liu Ying, Li Jinhua, Xu Xing, and Hou Lianhai.
facts.quote: named and described by Hu Dongyu, Liu Ying, Li Jinhua, Xu Xing and Hou Lianhai

facts.statement: The specific name 'viriosus' means 'powerful' in Latin, referring to the bird's large body size.
facts.quote: The specific name means "powerful" in Latin and refers to its relatively large body size

facts.statement: The fossil dates to the Aptian stage, approximately 120 million years ago.
facts.quote: dating to the Aptian, about 120 million years old

facts.statement: The femur of the holotype measures forty-three millimetres in length.
facts.quote: The femur has a length of forty-three millimetres

facts.statement: The wings and hindlimbs of Yuanjiawaornis were roughly the same length.
facts.quote: The wings and hindlimbs are roughly the same length

facts.statement: The lower leg formed a fused tibiotarsus over five centimetres long.
facts.quote: The lower leg forms a fused tibiotarsus over five centimetres long

facts.statement: The first toe claw was robust and strongly curved, directed backwards.
facts.quote: The first pedal ungual, which was directed backwards, is robust and strongly curved

facts.statement: The unfused hand in the holotype suggests the specimen was a young adult.
facts.quote: The hand is not fused in the holotype, a sign that it was a young adult specimen

facts.statement: Researchers placed the bird within Enantiornithes based on typical features like a Y-shaped wishbone and specific rib facets.
facts.quote: They deduced this from the possession of several typical enantiornithean features

facts.statement: The exact phylogenetic relationships of Yuanjiawaornis remain uncertain because the skull has not been found.
facts.quote: The exact relationships of the bird are uncertain, largely because the skull has not been found

facts.statement: The time range for the genus is estimated between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)
